pop.description: Proof that the caller controls the key behind the relationship's issuerDid, when the document's own proof signer is neither that issuer nor an administrator — i.e. for an edge published under a pairwise relationship DID. A member publishes an edge under a relationship DID, an identifier scoped to one counterparty, which names nobody; this document's own proof says only that a member sent the request, not that they control the edge's issuing key. Omit `pop` when the document's proof signer equals the relationship's issuerDid, or is an administrator: the document's own proof, or the administrator's standing, already establishes authority.

documentId.description: The `id` of the Trust Task document carrying this authorization. Binds the authorization to one document, so a captured one cannot be replayed in another — including by a different member.

proof.description: Data-integrity proof over this object, by a verification method the relationship's issuerDid controls. This is the proof of possession; the members above only bound what it authorizes.

relationship.description: The relationship id this authorization applies to. MUST equal the top-level `id`, so an authorization signed for one edge cannot be presented against another.

type.description: Distinct from vtc/relationships/publish's VrcPublishAuthorization, so a signature made to authorize a publish cannot be replayed here to authorize a revoke.
